notablePrerequisites: {1} fewer mana required on the first turn if Mystic Reflection was foretold.
description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Archaeomancer.
Cast Spore Swarm by paying {3}{G}, creating three token copies of Archaeomancer.
Each of the Archaeomancer's ETBs trigger, returning Mystic Reflection, Capture of Jingzhou, and Spore Swarm to your hand.
Repeat.
